buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of FA and CAO, ECoR, BBS payable at Sambalpur . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of FA and CAO, ECoR, BBS payable at Sambalpur . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA and CAO, ECoR, BBS A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Certificates

Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 7. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 8(A) Minimum Eligibility Criteria:- 8.A.1. EMD: The bidder should have paid EMD (Ref: EMD details of Bid Document @Page No.2/8) or submi tted valid MSE certificate for relevant Category as per Page No. 2/8 of GeM tender document to claim EMD exemption. 8.A.2. Work Experience: The bidder should have satisfactorily completed in three previous financial ye ars and the current financial year upto the date of opening of the tender, one single similar service contrac t** for a minimum of 35% of the advertised value of the bid. *Completed service contract includes on-going service contract subject to payment of bills amounting to a t least 35 % of the advertised value of the bid. **Similar service contract means any contract that is so specified by the competent authority. {Similar nature of services / works shall mean contract for all types of Providing Hired Vehicles Services co mpleted/ executed in Central or State Government/Semi-Government/PSU organization/ Public Listed Com pany. Copies of Contracts/ works orders and documentary evidence of successful execution/ completion in support of Past Experience of Services/Similar hired vehicle services shall be uploaded by the bidder along with its offer. Work experience certificate from private individual/company shall not be accepted.} Meaning of last three years of experience for documents: The last three financial years are 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 and current year 2026-27 up to date of tende r opening. So, bidders must submit experience certificates and turnover certificates for this duration only. Any experience before 31/03/2023 will not be considered to be valid. However, if any contract was issued before 01/04/2023 but has completed after 01/04/2023 shall be considered to have been completed durin g the above duration. 8.A.3. Financial standing:- Financial Turnover certificate: Bidder to submit financial turnover certificate during last three financial years, duly signed/stamped & certi fied by C.A and valid UDIN number. The minimum aggregate turnover during last three financial years sho uld be 150% of the tender value or the value as mentioned in the bid document, whichever is higher. Turn over values during last three financial years lower than required cut-off value shall be declared as invalid d ocument. The documents pertaining to filing of income tax returns etc. shall not be considered valid. 8.A.4. AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE ROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located int he state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. ** Statutory document (like GST Registration Certificate/Valid Deed Agreement etc.) to be considered for A

vailability of office address in the state of Consignee. 8.A.5. Bidder must upload annexure -A attached in Buyer added bid specific documents on (To be execut ed in presence of Public notary on non-judicial stamp paper of the value of Rs.100/-. The stamp has to be i n the name of the tenderer), failing which offer shall be summarily rejected. 8.A.6. Bidder must submit information/undertaking w.r.t. employment/partnership of retired Railway emplo yee as detailed in (Annexure- B). ** Annexure- A & B is uploaded in Buyer uploaded ATC Document. 8(B). OTHER INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS:- 8.B.1. Only those documents which were uploaded by bidders/sellers along with their original bid shall be considered for technical evaluation. Any documents submitted after the date of closing shall not be consid ered for evaluation. Further any document uploaded during representation stages shall also not be conside red for evaluation. 8.B.2. Document to be submitted along with bid: Seller has to submit following documents mandatorily along with bid. (a) Experience Certificate (b) Bidder Turnover Certificate (c) Compliance of Annexure-A & B (Annexure- A & B is uploaded in Buyer uploaded ATC Document) (d) Documentary Evidence for Availability of office address in the state of Consignee i.e. GST Registration Certificate/MSE Certificate/Valid Deed Agreement etc. (e) Scanned proof of the EMD submitted in the GeM tender, or the document for EMD exemption. 8.B.3 Completion Certificate Format The completion Certificate submitted by the bidder should contain the following information:- 1. Contract No. & Date: 2. Name of the Work: 3. Name of the Contractor: 4. Agreement Value: 5. Start Date: 6. Completion Date: 7. Completed Value / Up to date payment: 8. Performance: 9. Name of issuing Authority & Designation with Stamp and Name of issuing Organization. Note:- 1. Any completion Certificate without incomplete information is likely to be rejected. Note:-2. The completion Certificate and any other documents is likely to be cross-verified with the issuing Authority/Organization. If any facts or information is found to be false/incorrect, the offer will be rejected a nd/or the Contract will be terminated at the risk and cost of the bidder/contractor. Note:-3. Non-submission of any documents required in bid document will lead to rejection of offer during t echnical evaluation, and no correspondence s hall be entertained in this regard. 8.B.4 All services Contract in railways are governed by General Conditions of Contract (GCC) of Service-2018, available in Indian Railway website. . 9.
